question: What is the average review score for orders containing products in the furniture_decor category?
sql:
WITH furniture_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    WHERE ct.product_category_name_english = 'furniture_decor'
)
SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS average_review_score
FROM reviews r
JOIN furniture_orders fo ON r.order_id = fo.order_id

• Find order IDs that contain those product IDs by joining order_items.
• Join those order IDs to reviews to get review_score values.
• Compute the average of review_score across the resulting rows.
• No additional filters beyond the category condition are needed.
